notes: Live ticks only for P&L and lead time; archive Kalshi books were stale (~28s list prices).
Logs are Coinbase-only, not the live multi-exchange v48 BRTI approximation.
Gap correction is walk-forward (mean of earlier windows' official-BRTI minus Coinbase 60s close average).
Fills are one tick late (~1.06s) at that tick's ask (entry) or bid (swing exit). Taker fees on every leg.
First cross = first time that series crosses the strike in a given direction in the window.
Surprise = Kalshi YES mid was not yet on the crossed side of 50¢.

corr_surprise.note: both halves slightly positive but n=23, t=0.52 — not significant

last_cross_LOOKAHEAD_ONLY.note: Last cross is not tradeable: you only know it was last after the window ends. If price never recrosses, settlement matching that side is almost tautological until the last 60s average can still flip.

archive_gap.note: offset is not stable: live days mean $4.70, archive days mean $0.71

verdict: No tradeable after-fee edge. A real but short lead (~3–14s until Kalshi mid crosses 50 when it was not already there) is eaten by the spread plus two taker fees on swings. Did not add a v48 signal.
